entries.title: The Case of the Golden Idol
entries.definitive_edition: The Case of the Golden Idol Complete Edition / PC release with Golden Idol Mysteries DLC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release with the DLC installed; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Windows PC presentation with complete expansion content.

primary.version: Current PC release with Golden Idol Mysteries DLC / Complete Edition content
primary.why: The Windows PC route is the best archive version because it covers the base mystery game plus the two Golden Idol Mysteries expansions, The Spider of Lanka and The Lemurian Vampire, with PC capture/settings flexibility. Console and Netflix/mobile routes are useful access options, but no sourced platform-exclusive case content over the complete PC route is documented.
primary.how_to_play: Buy The Case of the Golden Idol on Windows PC and include the Golden Idol Mysteries DLC/Complete Edition content before starting the archive run.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release with the complete DLC route available.

entries.remaster_caveats: The Redux update refreshed the interface and hinting, but the important completeness gate is including the two Golden Idol Mysteries expansions.
